description.value: The Coconut is a South Indian restaurant in downtown Kamloops helmed by Chef Lalichan Joseph, whose background cooking aboard cruise lines shapes his commitment to quality and technique. The menu spans the regional breadth of South India — dosas, coconut curries, tandoori dishes, and street-food favourites — made with locally sourced west coast ingredients. Touring cyclists get a warm reception, with a customer-praised bike parking spot right out front and an extensive vegetarian menu.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (1 space) at 9m; rack (5 spaces) at 85m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms The Coconut is an active full-service South Indian dine-in restaurant in Kamloops offering dine-in, takeout, and delivery. A customer review on the homepage explicitly praises 'Rock star bicycle parking right out front,' which is the primary evidence for bike parking and the bike rack amenity. The website consistently lists the phone as +1 (250) 377-1160 across all pages, which differs from the OSM-recorded +1-250-828-6669; per rule 12 the website value is used and the discrepancy is flagged.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Established South Indian restaurant in downtown Kamloops with confirmed on-site bike parking and a strong vegetarian menu — a practical and appealing mid-ride or end-of-day stop for touring cyclists passing through the Thompson Valley.
